# TerraAgent

> Autonomous 3D planetary colony RTS in your browser (Three.js + WebGL2) on NEAR Protocol and hardware-attested NEAR.AI. Drop one robot, configure colony priorities, and let your settlement mine, terraform, trade, form treaties, and defend 24/7 on a deterministic 5 Hz simulation server.

## Gameplay Loop
- **Three Biomes:** Desert (`Kharon Dunes`, solar-rich, water-scarce), Ocean (`Thalassa Verde`, water/biomass-rich, hydro-friendly), and Temperate (`Granite Hollow`, mineral-dense, forested).
- **24-Hour Matchmaking Window:** Planets accept new colonies until sector seats fill or 24 hours pass since first landing, then seal and run up to 14 days toward the S10 Ascension Rocket.
- **10 Surface & Orbital Commodities (`NEP-245` on `res.terraagent.testnet`):** Iron (`metals.t1`), Light Alloys (`metals.t2`), Titanium (`metals.t3`), Silica (`minerals.t1`), Rare Earths (`minerals.t2`), Exotic Crystal (`minerals.t3`), Water (`bio.water`), Biomass (`bio.biomass`), Petroleum (`bio.t2`), and Gene-stock (`bio.t3`).
- **Continuous Rule Engine + Governed AI:** 90–95% of tick logic runs deterministically at 5 Hz on `@terra/sim`; emergencies and offline sweeps route to bounded `NEAR.AI` Directors.

## 4 Organic Income Lanes (Zero Token Printing / Zero Pay-to-Win)
1. **Cargo Exports (100% to Seller):** Refine commodities across MK.I–MK.III buildings, ship surplus via Trade Hub to mint 1:1 `NEP-245` cargo, and sell for USDC, NEAR, or barter cargo on `/trade.html`.
2. **Trade Hub Stall Royalties (0–1.00%):** Every Trade Hub operates as an orderbook storefront earning 0–100 bp maker royalties on filled orders.
3. **Scoped Trading Bots (24/7):** Mint revocable `ta_bot_...` API keys with daily spend caps and price-band checks to run automated market-making and arbitrage on the planet CLOB.
4. **Mercenary Bounties & Bonded Diplomacy (90% / 10% Slashes):** Claim raid-defense bounties or lock NEAR / cargo escrows for Peace Treaties (2h–72h) and 6h War Bonds (`2x` Raider carry cap). Honored treaties and completed war goals refund 100%; early betrayal or failed sieges slash 90% to the counterparty and 10% to Protocol.

## Day-1 Lossless Staking & TerraAgent Protocol Treasury
- **Lossless Staking (`staking.terraagent.testnet`, Human-Only):** On a 9.0% gross validator pool (2-day unbonding), pilots keep 100% principal plus 80% of yield (`7.20%` net APY), while 20% (`1.80%` APY) funds `TerraAgent Protocol`.
- **Staker Perks (`>= 10 NEAR`):** Unlocks server-sponsored Managed `NEAR.AI` Autopilot and a 50% platform trade fee cut (`1.00%` -> `0.50%`) with zero combat or harvesting buffs.
- **4-Way Atomic `NEP-413` Settlement:** Buyer notional clears atomically across Seller Principal (`100%`), Trade Hub Stall (`0–1.00%`), Planet Council DAO (`20%` of platform fee), and `protocol.terraagent.*` (`80%` of platform fee).
- **Self-Funded Operating Budgets:** Organic trade shares, validator yield slices, and bond slashes cover `NEP-366` gasless player meta-transactions (`relayer.terraagent.*`) and batched `NEAR AI Cloud` TEE turns (`~$0.03–$0.05/planet/day`, breaking even at `~$7/day` trade volume or `200 NEAR` staked TVL).

## 6 Deployed NEAR Rust Smart Contracts (`near-sdk 5.7`)
- `res.terraagent.testnet` — `NEP-245` Orbital Resource Multi-Token (`mt_mint`, `mt_burn`, `mt_batch_transfer`, `mt_transfer_call`, `mt_withdraw`)
- `deed.terraagent.testnet` — `NEP-171` Soulbound Colony Deeds (`mint_deed`, `update_metadata`, `prune_history`, `NEP-181` pagination)
- `bounty.terraagent.testnet` — Mercenary Bounties, Bonded Peace Treaties & 6h War Escrows (`open_near_escrow`, `slash_escrow`, `claim_expired_refund`)
- `staking.terraagent.testnet` — Day-1 Lossless Staking Vault (`stake_payable`, LST `ft_on_transfer`, human-only enforcement)
- `dao.terraagent.testnet` — Planet Council Treasury & Voting (`propose`, `vote`, `finalize`, SputnikDAO v2 export)
- `pilots.terraagent.testnet` — Cold-Root Pilot Sub-Account Factory (`create_pilot_account`)

## Verifiable NEAR.AI TEE Commander & Agent Commerce
- **Hardware-Attested Enclaves:** Rival AI directors and Managed Staker Autopilot batch `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` sweeps on `cloud-api.near.ai/v1` with staker prompt isolation and `<untrusted_player_label>` injection filtering.
- **Browser-Verifiable Proofs:** `/v1/signature/{chat_id}` (`SHA-256` `model:request:response` `secp256k1` EIP-191 / `Ed25519`) persists to `DirectorTeeAttestation` and verifies directly in-browser (`TEE ✓` HUD modal and `/me.html` live enclave probe).
- **Encrypted BYOK Vault:** Pilots can save personal `AES-256-GCM` encrypted NEAR AI Cloud keys on `/me.html` across `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash`, `z-ai/glm-5.3`, `deepseek/deepseek-v3.2`, `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017`, `Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B`, `openai/gpt-5-mini`, `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6`, or custom models.
- **Hosted MCP Server & Shade MPC:** External agents discover pair specs via `GET /v1/mcp/agent-market.json`, call JSON-RPC 2.0 tools on `POST /v1/mcp` or `POST /v1/trade/agent/rfq`, and run decentralized Shade Agents signing with `v1.signer`.
